# Regulatory mapping

<!-- Generated by `python -m dora_roi.docs`; do not edit by hand. -->

This document links every validation rule of the toolkit to the provision of Regulation (EU) 2022/2554 (DORA) or of the Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2956 (ITS on RoI templates) that it supports. It is generated from the rule registry, so it always matches the code.

> The references express *which obligation a rule helps evidence*; they are the authors' interpretation (see [ASSUMPTIONS.md](ASSUMPTIONS.md), in particular A-VAL-* and A-REG-01) and are not the official EBA validation rules.

**62 rules.** Severity: *error* blocks a clean submission, *warning* needs review, *info* is for awareness.

## Import checks (IMP)

| Rule | Severity | Check | Templates | Supports |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `IMP-001` | info | **Unrecognised sheet or file ignored** – A sheet/file whose name does not match any RoI template was skipped. | — | ITS Annex I |
| `IMP-002` | warning | **Template missing from input** – No sheet/file was found for a template; it is treated as empty. | all templates | DORA Art. 28(3); ITS Annex I |
| `IMP-003` | warning | **Unknown column ignored** – A column header is not a column code of the template; values are ignored. | all templates | ITS Annex I |
| `IMP-004` | error | **Header row not found** – No row of column codes (c0010, c0020, …) could be located in the sheet. | all templates | ITS Annex I |

## Field-level checks (FLD)

| Rule | Severity | Check | Templates | Supports |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FLD-001` | error | **Mandatory value missing** – Every column flagged mandatory (M) in the ITS must be reported for each row. | all templates | DORA Art. 28(3); ITS Annex I; ITS Annex II |
| `FLD-002` | error | **Invalid LEI** – LEI must be 20 alphanumeric characters with valid MOD 97-10 check digits. | all templates | ISO 17442; ITS Art. – identification |
| `FLD-003` | error | **Invalid date** – Dates must be valid calendar dates in ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD. | all templates | ISO 8601; ITS Annex II |
| `FLD-004` | error | **Value not in code list** – Closed-list columns only accept the values defined by the ITS. | all templates | ITS Annex II; ITS Annex III |
| `FLD-005` | error | **Invalid country code** – Countries must be ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (e.g. GB, not UK). | all templates | ISO 3166-1; ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 30(2) |
| `FLD-006` | error | **Invalid currency code** – Currencies must be active ISO 4217 alphabetic codes. | all templates | ISO 4217; ITS Annex II |
| `FLD-007` | error | **Invalid number** – Monetary amounts, day counts, hours and ranks must be non-negative numbers of the expected type (integers where required). | all templates | ITS Annex II |
| `FLD-008` | error | **Invalid boolean** – Yes/no columns must be true or false. | all templates | ITS Annex II |
| `FLD-009` | error | **Text too long** – Alphanumeric values are limited to 255 characters. | all templates | ITS Annex II; EBA reporting |
| `FLD-010` | error | **Duplicate record key** – Each template has a primary key (e.g. the contractual arrangement reference number in B_02.01); the same key must not be reported twice. | all templates | ITS Annex II; ITS Art. – consistency |
| `FLD-011` | error | **B_01.01 must contain exactly one row** – The register is maintained by exactly one entity, reported in B_01.01. | B_01.01 | DORA Art. 28(3); ITS Annex I |
| `FLD-012` | error | **Core template is empty** – A register without entities, contracts, providers or functions cannot be submitted. | B_01.02, B_02.01, B_02.02, B_05.01, B_06.01 | DORA Art. 28(3); ITS Annex I |
| `FLD-013` | error | **Provider code inconsistent with its code type** – When the type of code is LEI the identification code must be a valid LEI; when it is EUID it must start with an ISO country code followed by the register identifier. | B_02.02, B_03.02, B_05.01, B_05.02, B_07.01 | ISO 17442; ITS Art. – identification |

## Cross-template referential integrity (XRF)

| Rule | Severity | Check | Templates | Supports |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `XRF-001` | error | **Contractual arrangement not defined in B_02.01** – Every contractual arrangement reference number used in another template must be reported in B_02.01. | all templates | ITS Art. – consistency; ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(3) |
| `XRF-002` | error | **Entity not listed in B_01.02** – Every entity LEI used in the register (maintainer, branch head office, service user, signatory, function owner) must be listed in B_01.02. | all templates | ITS Art. – consistency; ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(3); ITS Art. – identification |
| `XRF-003` | error | **ICT third-party service provider not listed in B_05.01** – Every provider (direct provider, signatory, subcontractor or recipient of subcontracted services) must be described in B_05.01. | B_02.02, B_03.02, B_05.02, B_07.01 | ITS Art. – consistency; ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(3); DORA Art. 28(3) |
| `XRF-004` | error | **Function not identified in B_06.01** – Each function supported by an ICT service in B_02.02 must be identified and assessed for criticality in B_06.01. | B_02.02, B_06.01 | ITS Art. – consistency; ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(3); DORA Art. 28(3); DORA Art. 3(22) |
| `XRF-005` | warning | **Function identified for a different entity** – The function exists in B_06.01 but not for the entity making use of the ICT service; check that the right function identifier/LEI pair is reported. | B_02.02, B_06.01 | ITS Art. – consistency; ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(3) |
| `XRF-006` | error | **Contractual arrangement without specific information** – Every arrangement in B_02.01 must be described by at least one row in B_02.02 (entity, provider, function and service type). | B_02.01, B_02.02 | ITS Art. – consistency; ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(3) |
| `XRF-007` | error | **Contractual arrangement without signing entity** – Each arrangement must identify the entity (or entities) of the group that signed it, in B_03.01 (or B_03.03 for intra-group provision). | B_02.01, B_03.01, B_03.03 | ITS Art. – consistency; ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(3) |
| `XRF-008` | warning | **Provider in B_02.02 not reported as signatory in B_03.02** – The ICT third-party service provider of an arrangement is expected to be reported as signatory of that arrangement in B_03.02. | B_02.02, B_03.02 | ITS Art. – consistency; ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(3) |
| `XRF-009` | warning | **Contractual arrangement without service recipient in B_04.01** – The entities making use of the ICT services of each arrangement are expected in B_04.01. | B_02.01, B_04.01 | ITS Art. – consistency; ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(3) |
| `XRF-010` | warning | **Provider not used by any arrangement** – A provider in B_05.01 that is neither a direct provider (B_02.02) nor part of a supply chain (B_05.02) or ultimate parent is probably stale. | B_05.01 | ITS Art. – consistency; ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(3) |
| `XRF-011` | error | **Overarching arrangement reference does not resolve** – A subsequent/associated arrangement must point to an arrangement reported in B_02.01 whose type is 'overarching'. | B_02.01 | ITS Art. – consistency; ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(3) |
| `XRF-012` | error | **Branch not listed in B_01.03** – A branch making use of ICT services must be listed in B_01.03 under the same head office LEI. | B_04.01, B_01.03 | ITS Art. – consistency; ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(3) |
| `XRF-013` | error | **Assessment does not match any ICT service in B_02.02** – Each B_07.01 row (arrangement, provider, service type) must correspond to an ICT service reported in B_02.02. | B_07.01, B_02.02 | ITS Art. – consistency; ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(3) |
| `XRF-014` | info | **Parent undertaking outside the register scope** – The direct parent LEI is not itself listed in B_01.02. This is legitimate when the parent is outside the scope (e.g. a third-country holding) but should be confirmed. | B_01.02 | ITS Art. – consistency; ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(3) |
| `XRF-015` | info | **Entity in scope does not use any ICT service** – An entity listed in B_01.02 is not referenced by any arrangement. Confirm that its ICT services are captured (possibly via another group entity). | B_01.02 | DORA Art. 28(3) |

## ICT supply chain / subcontracting (SC)

| Rule | Severity | Check | Templates | Supports |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SC-001` | error | **Rank 1 provider is not the direct provider of the arrangement** – The rank 1 entry of a supply chain must be the ICT third-party service provider that provides the service under the arrangement (as reported in B_02.02). | B_05.02, B_02.02 | DORA Art. 28(3); DORA Art. 29; DORA Art. 30(2); ITS Annex II |
| `SC-002` | error | **Subcontractor without recipient** – Entries with rank greater than 1 must identify the recipient of the sub-contracted ICT services (c0060/c0070). | B_05.02 | DORA Art. 28(3); DORA Art. 29; DORA Art. 30(2); ITS Annex II |
| `SC-003` | error | **Subcontracting chain does not resolve** – The recipient of a rank n subcontractor must appear as provider at rank n-1 of the same arrangement and service type; otherwise the chain is broken (missing link). | B_05.02 | DORA Art. 28(3); DORA Art. 29; DORA Art. 30(2); ITS Annex II |
| `SC-004` | warning | **Recipient reported for a rank 1 provider** – The direct provider (rank 1) has no recipient of sub-contracted services. | B_05.02 | DORA Art. 28(3); DORA Art. 29; DORA Art. 30(2); ITS Annex II |
| `SC-005` | error | **Circular subcontracting chain** – A provider cannot (directly or indirectly) subcontract to itself within the same chain. | B_05.02 | DORA Art. 28(3); DORA Art. 29; DORA Art. 30(2); ITS Annex II |
| `SC-006` | warning | **No supply chain reported for an ICT service supporting a critical function** – ICT services supporting critical or important functions are expected to have their supply chain (at least the rank 1 provider) reported in B_05.02. | B_05.02, B_02.02, B_06.01 | DORA Art. 28(3); DORA Art. 29; DORA Art. 30(2); ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(8) |

## Business and conditional rules (BUS)

| Rule | Severity | Check | Templates | Supports |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BUS-001` | error | **End date before start date** – The end date of a contractual arrangement cannot precede its start date. | B_02.02 | ITS Annex II |
| `BUS-002` | error | **Termination reason missing for an ended arrangement** – When the arrangement ended on or before the reference date, the reason of termination or ending (c0090) must be reported. | B_02.02 | ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(7) |
| `BUS-003` | warning | **Termination reason reported for an active arrangement** – A termination reason only applies to arrangements that have ended. | B_02.02 | ITS Annex II |
| `BUS-004` | error | **Data storage location missing** – When the ICT service includes storage of data (c0140 = true), the country of the data at rest (c0150) must be reported. | B_02.02 | ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 30(2) |
| `BUS-005` | error | **Data sensitivity missing** – When the ICT service includes storage of data, the sensitiveness of the data (c0170) must be reported. | B_02.02 | ITS Annex II |
| `BUS-006` | warning | **Data processing location missing** – Where data is stored by the provider it is normally also processed; the location of management of the data (c0160) is expected. | B_02.02 | ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 30(2) |
| `BUS-007` | error | **Arrangement type inconsistent with overarching reference** – A subsequent/associated arrangement must reference its overarching arrangement (c0030); standalone and overarching arrangements must not. | B_02.01 | ITS Annex II |
| `BUS-008` | warning | **Currency differs from the reporting currency** – Amounts are expected in the reporting currency of the entity maintaining the register so that they can be aggregated. | B_02.01, B_05.01 | ITS Annex II |
| `BUS-009` | warning | **Provider total cost lower than sum of its arrangements** – The total annual expense of a provider (B_05.01 c0100) should be at least the sum of the annual cost of its arrangements (B_02.01 c0050), in the same currency. | B_05.01, B_02.01 | ITS Annex II |
| `BUS-010` | error | **Group hierarchy inconsistent with parent LEI** – Subsidiaries and intermediate parents must report the LEI of their direct parent (c0060); an ultimate parent or stand-alone entity must not. | B_01.02 | ITS Annex II |
| `BUS-011` | error | **Deletion date before integration date** – An entity cannot leave the register before it was integrated. | B_01.02 | ITS Annex II |
| `BUS-012` | warning | **Date after the reference date** – Last update, integration, assessment and audit dates are historical and should not lie after the reporting reference date. | B_01.02, B_06.01, B_07.01 | ITS Annex II |
| `BUS-013` | error | **Branch code missing for a branch** – When the entity making use of the services is a branch (c0030 = true), its identification code (c0040) is required. | B_04.01 | ITS Annex II |
| `BUS-014` | error | **Additional identification code without type** – An additional provider code (c0030) requires its type (c0040) and vice versa. | B_05.01 | ITS Annex II |
| `BUS-015` | error | **Critical function lacks justification or recovery objectives** – For critical or important functions the reasons for criticality (c0060), RTO (c0080) and RPO (c0090) must be reported. | B_06.01 | ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 3(22); DORA Art. 28(4) |
| `BUS-016` | warning | **Criticality assessment not performed** – Every function supported by ICT third-party services should be assessed for criticality or importance. | B_06.01 | DORA Art. 28(4); DORA Art. 3(22) |
| `BUS-017` | warning | **Criticality assessment out of date** – The last criticality assessment is older than the configured maximum age (default 12 months) at the reference date. | B_06.01 | DORA Art. 28(4) |
| `BUS-018` | error | **ICT service supporting a critical function not assessed in B_07.01** – Each ICT service supporting a critical or important function must have an assessment (substitutability, exit plan, reintegration) in B_07.01. | B_07.01, B_02.02 | DORA Art. 28(3); DORA Art. 29; ITS Annex I |
| `BUS-019` | error | **No exit plan for an ICT service supporting a critical function** – Financial entities must have exit strategies for ICT services supporting critical or important functions; B_07.01 c0080 must be true. | B_07.01, B_06.01 | DORA Art. 28(8); DORA Art. 30(3) |
| `BUS-020` | error | **Reason for non-substitutability missing** – When the provider is not substitutable or highly complex to substitute, the reason (c0060) must be given. | B_07.01 | ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 29 |
| `BUS-021` | error | **Alternative providers not identified** – When alternative providers are said to be identified (c0110 = true), they must be named (c0120). | B_07.01 | ITS Annex II; DORA Art. 28(8) |
| `BUS-022` | warning | **Provider supporting a critical function not audited recently** – Providers of ICT services supporting critical functions should be audited with a risk-based frequency; no audit date or an audit older than the configured threshold (default 3 years) is flagged. | B_07.01 | DORA Art. 28(6) |
| `BUS-023` | warning | **Intra-group provider without B_03.03 entry** – When the provider of an arrangement is itself an entity of the group (its LEI is in B_01.02), the providing entity is expected in B_03.03. | B_03.03, B_02.02 | ITS Annex II |
| `BUS-024` | info | **Indefinite arrangement reported with an unusual end date** – Arrangements without an end date are reported as 9999-12-31; end dates more than 30 years ahead are usually a placeholder that should be normalised. | B_02.02 | ITS Annex II |

## Provisions referenced

| Reference | Meaning |
|---|---|
| DORA Art. 3(22) | Definition of 'critical or important function'. |
| DORA Art. 28(3) | Maintain and update a register of information on all contractual arrangements on the use of ICT services provided by ICT third-party service providers, at entity, sub-consolidated and consolidated level, distinguishing arrangements covering critical or important functions; report it to the competent authority on request. |
| DORA Art. 28(4) | Pre-contractual assessment, including whether the arrangement covers a critical or important function. |
| DORA Art. 28(6) | Frequency of audits and inspections determined on a risk basis. |
| DORA Art. 28(7) | Termination rights of the financial entity. |
| DORA Art. 28(8) | Exit strategies for ICT services supporting critical or important functions. |
| DORA Art. 29 | Preliminary assessment of ICT concentration risk at entity level, including substitutability and subcontracting chains. |
| DORA Art. 30(2) | Key contractual provisions, incl. description of services, subcontracting conditions and locations of service provision and data processing. |
| DORA Art. 30(3) | Additional provisions for critical or important functions, incl. notice periods and exit strategies. |
| ITS Annex I | Templates of the register of information (B_01.01 – B_07.01). |
| ITS Annex II | Instructions for completing the templates. |
| ITS Annex III | Taxonomy of ICT service types. |
| ITS Art. – identification | Entities identified by LEI; providers by LEI or EUID. |
| ITS Art. – consistency | Information across templates must be consistent and linked through the contractual arrangement reference number and identification codes. |
| ISO 17442 | Legal Entity Identifier format and MOD 97-10 check digits. |
| ISO 3166-1 | Country codes (alpha-2). |
| ISO 4217 | Currency codes. |
| ISO 8601 | Date format YYYY-MM-DD. |
| EBA reporting | EBA reporting framework / xBRL-CSV technical requirements (filing rules for DORA RoI). |
